surfaces.label: Loopback client can evict all eligible GPU models without an owner capability
surfaces.notes: Only eligible idle models with unload callbacks are evicted and failure is reported. A same-user malicious process can already consume equivalent host resources; no durable state or secret is affected.

surfaces.label: Each unauthenticated GPU SSE connection starts an uncapped polling loop
surfaces.notes: Each loop sleeps five seconds and exits on disconnect; no durable state, privilege, secret, or cross-user boundary impact is shown. The same-user process can consume CPU/memory directly.

surfaces.label: Preview rendering duration has no upper bound
surfaces.notes: Clip spans and per-segment 60-second timeouts constrain units of work; no durable corruption or privilege boundary is shown, and the same-user caller can consume comparable resources directly.

surfaces.label: Video import accepts an unbounded path list and performs expensive work sequentially
surfaces.notes: Each path is policy-checked, probed, and hashed; no cross-boundary read or durable corruption is established for this unbounded-list row. The same-user process can generate equivalent I/O directly.

surfaces.label: A still-runnable archived model downloader enables Hugging Face remote Python code without pinning a repository revision or verifying downloaded code
surfaces.notes: The file is under archive/tools-old, is not invoked by release/setup/runtime workflows, and the prerequisite already requires deliberate developer execution of obsolete tooling. This is not the shipped model-provisioning path.
